authority: Robert's direct approval in this chat on 18 October 2026. This records product direction and bounded verification authority, not migrations/provider activation/deployment permission.

verification.tooling: Narrow test/config repairs: exclude generated Next outputs from lint, diagnose local transport and Git-check timeout, isolate build-generated files. No skipped assertions, threshold inflation, Git repair or live-preview disruption.
verification.fonts: Credential-free build-only requests to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com permitted only if exact egress restrictions and output isolation can be enforced. All application providers remain blocked; stop rather than broaden access.
verification.browser: Short designated local QA session with Robert operating Cancel/Leave when automated checks are ready. No unrelated tabs or foreground interference.

programme.baseline: Proposal should offer a high-level elemental timeline/mini Gantt by default, expandable to more detailed contractor planning. Examples are examples, not automatic templates or invented activities.
programme.timeBasis: Support a target commencement date when known; otherwise relative Day 1 to Day N with duration. Do not invent a calendar start date.
programme.optional: Contractor can explicitly remove the programme. This is not approval to silently omit an absent/invalid saved programme or simply relabel the existing mandatory readiness row.
programme.remainingSpecification: Explicit include/omit intent, minimum programme validity, date-versus-relative rendering and storage/readiness/document integration need a source-grounded slice. No minimum fixed activity count, work calendar, automatic template or schema migration selected.

experienceDirection.reference: TeamGantt overall, especially Robert's supplied simplified timeline illustrations.
experienceDirection.advanced: Optional cleaner advanced grid; Smartsheet secondary cue, not overall dependency-interface approval.
experienceDirection.default: Simple labelled visual activities and milestones, restrained purposeful colours, professional depth progressively revealed.
experienceDirection.tracking: Current/baseline comparison and day variances are later design references, not implemented tracking or a chosen calculation policy.
experienceDirection.limits: Existing date/relative/include-omit/calendar decisions and execution gates unchanged; screenshots do not authorise sharing, provider actions or migrations.

jobTypes.approved: Custom contractor-written types alongside a small set of examples; same choices across create/settings and chosen wording on proposal as recommended.
jobTypes.direction: Learn from the contractor's prior job types and trade, such as extensions or plumbing work. Suggestions should help, not impose inaccurate categories.
jobTypes.limits: No AI/provider activation, new history/profile query or discipline mapping silently authorised. First increment can add custom entry with existing save paths after current-source compatibility checks.

measurement.approved: Result-only length x width aid for the no-schema increment; explicit use to fill quantity, dimensions not retained on reopening. Durable editable measurements remain separate remaining work.
measurement.precision: Exact decimal multiplication. Fill existing quantity only when exact product has no more than three decimal places; otherwise explain refusal. No silent rounding, unit conversion, waste or deductions.

pricing.approved: Retain simple lump-sum pricing, all-in unit rate and optional component rate build-up accessible from the line-editing journey. Encourage but do not require detailed pricing.
pricing.components: Multiple named labour, plant, material and subcontract rows, with quantities per unit of priced work as recommended, producing a unit rate. Existing arithmetic/persistence requires source-grounded design and tests before alteration.
pricing.direction: Support contractor learning over time; no automated recommendations/provider activation implied.

experienceDirection.reference: STACK's clean presentation, not a literal worksheet clone.
experienceDirection.default: Streamlined everyday pricing; advanced worksheet/resource detail optional.
experienceDirection.calculations: Software performs the mathematics. Contractors enter quantities/rates/assumptions rather than formulas.
experienceDirection.guidance: Genuine job-aware chatbot guides the process; reviewed user-controlled changes. Provider/model/data/cost activation remains separately gated.

address.approved: Preserve existing free text untouched unless deliberately edited. Opt-in fresh structured site/client entry, unstructured fallback for unusual sites; no guess-conversion or silent client-as-site fallback as recommended.
address.desiredIntegration: Address search/autocomplete that supplies postcode/location is desired. Provider, geography, cost, credentials, privacy and activation are not chosen or authorised. No lookup calls in this increment.
address.remainingSpecification: Field set, joining/save rules, limits and compatibility with existing addresses must be specified before source implementation; no migration permission.

unchangedLimits: Only sibling constructa checkout; preserve all uncommitted work/live outputs/unsaved tabs. No migration, hosted write expansion, provider activation, secrets, account reset, push/PR/CI/workflow/deployment or publication. Earlier failed receipts remain issued; product direction is not acceptance evidence.

platformVision.direction: Constructa should become the integrated place contractors run projects: estimating, planning and project delivery together, rather than separate schedule-only or estimate-only products. Preserve existing phase-two/three work and stage the broader platform around a dependable phase-one workflow.
platformVision.delivery: A clean visual foundation can be delivered incrementally. A dependable integrated project-running platform is substantial staged product work; the screenshots do not prove full capability is easy or already built.
